<function name="SetAngles" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the angles of the entity.

<note>To set a player's angles, use <page>Player:SetEyeAngles</page> instead.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="angles" type="Angle">The new angles.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
